movement_source: row 'Common Equity Tier 1', column FY20 (Jun 20) -> column FY21 (Jun 21)
headline: CBA's APRA Level 2 CET1 ratio increased by 150 bps from 11.6% in FY20 to 13.1% in FY21. The bank attributes this primarily to strong organic capital generation (+46 bps), partially offset by dividends paid (-91 bps) and an off-market buy-back (-133 bps). Divestments contributed +44 bps, while regulatory changes added +17 bps. A residual of +133 bps remains unexplained by the specific drivers listed in the pro-forma walk.

drivers.bank_label: Organic (net of growth / investment, ex dividends)
drivers.narrative: The bank reports 'Organic' capital generation as +180 bps in its pro-forma walk (ev-13). This is a net figure including growth/investment impacts but excluding dividends. Note: The half-on-half walk (ev-1) shows Cash NPAT at +97 bps and RWA at +8 bps for Dec 20-Jun 21, which does not sum to this FY20-FY21 figure.

Dividends paid reduced the ratio by 91 bps (ev-13, ev-32). The interim dividend included on-market share purchases for the DRP (ev-2). This figure is from the pro-forma walk and may differ from the statutory cash flow impact.
An off-market buy-back reduced the ratio by 133 bps (ev-13, ev-33). This is a significant capital return event reported in the pro-forma walk.

Divestments contributed +44 bps (ev-13, ev-30). This includes the sale of CommInsure Life (+2 bpts per ev-8) and expected uplifts from Colonial First State and CommInsure General Insurance (ev-9, ev-29).

Regulatory changes, specifically the APRA Overlay Release and revised APS 111, contributed +17 bps (ev-13, ev-31). Revised APS 111 is expected to provide further uplift of 15-20 bps from Jan 2022 (ev-10).

disagreements.preferred: Pro-forma Walk (ev-13) used for driver attribution due to span match, despite pro-forma endpoint
disagreements.explanation: The bank provides no audited walk for the exact FY20->FY21 statutory movement. The only walk covering the correct start/end dates (ev-13) uses a pro-forma end point that excludes the buy-back. We use its bars for attribution but must account for the residual caused by the buy-back being excluded from the pro-forma sum.

limitations: No primary walk exists for the exact FY20->FY21 statutory movement. Attribution relies on the pro-forma walk (ev-13) which has a different endpoint.

The residual of +133 bps exactly equals the magnitude of the off-market buy-back, suggesting the 'Organic' bar in the pro-forma walk might be mislabeled or that the buy-back was double-counted or excluded incorrectly in the pro-forma calculation relative to the statutory delta.
Confidence is capped because we are attributing drivers from a pro-forma context to a statutory movement without a direct reconciliation table.
